description:
Get the exact TypeScript signatures of the sandbox functions that `execute` scripts can call.
Analyze the user request first, then pass `names` with only the functions the request needs (every name is listed in this input schema / description); omit `names` only when you cannot tell which functions apply.
Always call this before your first `execute` and never guess signatures. Request every function the task may need in ONE call instead of calling this repeatedly.

names.description: Names of the sandbox functions to discover: listApis, getEndpoints, getEndpointInfo, getSecuritySchemes, getFullApiDescription, search, listPages, getPage, grepPages. Omit to discover all of them.

name: discover
title: Get docs function signatures
